limitations: Historical dates and prior strategy outcomes have been examined repeatedly; this is exploratory validation, not an untouched holdout.
Current swap snapshot held constant over history, with historical constant EUR tick valuation. Daily historical financing and conversion rates unavailable.
MT5 returned invalid triple-day code7; explicit Wednesday triple assumption retained. Primary broker midnight GMT+3 with GMT+2 sensitivity; historical clock/DST policy not reconstructed.
Stress doubles commissions, adverse market/stop slippage and negative swap debits, leaves credits unchanged. Observed spreads unchanged; fallback1 to2 pips.
Independent continuous EUR10k accounts per window/model; no monthly resets or concurrent portfolio aggregation. Drawdown samples M1-close equity and actual fills; intrabar loss can be larger.
Historical margin, execution latency, missing liquidity, tick paths and changing broker stop/volume constraints not reconstructed. No live settings, bot or orders.
live_status: Research policies only; core replay and live configurations unchanged; terminal initialization/order APIs forbidden.

variants.baseline: Old M30/M1,1.5R activation/1R trailing gap; SELL flat only before triple swap
variants.buy_only: Same baseline but BUY signals only; positive assumed BUY financing
variants.sell_only: Same baseline but SELL signals only; pre-triple SELL exit retained
variants.fixed_2r: Same baseline entries/initial risk; fixed2R TP, trailing off
variants.agent_positive: Monthly gate: allow each side with >=8 closed shadow trades in preceding180days and positive mean stressed netR; otherwise cash
variants.agent_best: Same monthly training, allow only highest positive mean stressed netR side; ties BUY; otherwise cash

control_reuse: 12 triple-exit accounts copied exactly after original-source/history/config checks; only scenario labels renamed
selection: Earlier GMT+3 stressed net only, highest positive versus cash0; ties lower drawdown then name; lock before later/full new hypotheses. Rank all later/full results descriptively; no promotion from those reused dates.
agent_protocol: UTC monthly refit, preceding180 calendar days, shadow triple-exit reference trades EXITED strictly before month start, >=8 per side, positive mean net/initial cash price risk. Stressed reference outcomes train BOTH normal/stressed agent replays; clock-specific financing. No current-month exit labels, open trade outcomes, future prices or ongoing agent PnL used. Cold-start sides remain off. Initial history only begins at first reference entry; no invented warmup. Existing positions keep original exits when advice changes.
agent_limits: Deterministic adviser without execution dependencies. Simulated entry gate only; does not generate new market signals or claim general AI knowledge/guaranteed returns. Agent can reduce opportunity and overfit; shadow strategy is fixed based on reused historical research.
risk_unchanged: EUR10k,0.5% initial price risk,current equity sizing,maxlot0.5,one position,20pipSL,spread0.9,sessions,cooldown,dailyEUR150 and loss guards unchanged. Only direction gate or fixed2R exit differs. No stop widening or volume increase.
